metrics.trend: Eval rising throughout: 39→144→141→164→141→172→209→197→236→279→268. Value peaks at 110.91@65K then self-corrects downward to 67.27@105K. v/e ratio peaks 0.57@55K then monotonically declines to 0.25@105K. NO delusional critic collapse — value self-corrects while eval improves.
metrics.verdict: SUCCESS — no delusional critic collapse. Normalized v/e > 1.5 only at 25K-45K (early noisy phase), drops below 1.0 after 65K and stays at 0.38-0.66x. Value self-corrects. Collapse NOT reproduced in seed 2.
metrics.causal_conclusion: CRITICAL: Seed 2 does NOT reproduce seed 1's delusional critic collapse. 008d seed 1: v/e accelerated 15.5%→166.6%, eval collapsed 167→83. 009b seed 2: v/e peaked 57% then self-corrected to 25.1%, eval rose to 268. The trained dt_embedding → delusional critic claim is NOT robust across seeds. Comparison with 009c (no dt_embed, seed 2): 009c eval=148@105K (declining), 009b eval=268@105K (rising). Ironically, WITH dt_embedding outperforms WITHOUT in seed 2 — opposite of C2 narrative. Both seeds underperform baseline (~70-84% gap) due to H=8 regime difficulty, not value overestimation.
